about: tandem remote: the engine's control verbs (1.1 adds ext, upgrade and token). One command line (SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND under a forced command, else the arguments), split without a shell; one JSON document on stdout (JSON lines for logs --follow); an exit status; a journal line a call. server/remote/grammar.py VERBS is this table; tests/test_remote_contract.py holds them equal.

line.token: printable ASCII, no space (after shlex's POSIX quoting)

kinds.when: now, idle or at=<ISO 8601 time with a zone, at most 7 days ahead>
kinds.sha256: the 64 hex digits of a sha256
kinds.ref: a tag, a branch or a commit (no option, range or ..)

upgrade plan.stdin: with --sha256: the tree as a tar or tar.gz archive (at most 512 MiB)

planned.models: a later minor of this contract; refused as unknown_verb until then
planned.pair: a later minor of this contract; refused as unknown_verb until then

exit.1: answered, not ok (doctor found problems; ext install or remove: ops/venv-wheel.sh failed)
exit.2: usage: the command does not parse
exit.3: refused: the session, a path, a key, a missing confirm, the overlay hook

journal.redacted: the value of every secret-looking KEY=VALUE or --name VALUE
journal.checked: ext install and upgrade: the sha256 (and the size) of the bytes the call read and checked, refused ones too

files.run/managed.env: the current overlay version, read by ops/serve.env after run/local.env
files.run/remote/stopped: a stop on purpose; ops/watchdog.sh leaves the engine down
files.logs/launcher.log: what the jobs' ops/start.sh and ops/stop.sh printed
files.run/remote/extensions.json: the extensions ext install put into the venv: distribution -> module, version, wheel, sha256
files.run/remote/wheels/: a wheel while ext install installs it (removed after)
files.run/remote/upgrades/<sha256>.tar: a planned upgrade's archive (the two newest are kept)
files.run/remote/upgrades/<job>/: an upgrade job's previous run/ops, bin/tandem and install.sh (the three newest)
files.refs/tandem/previous, refs/tandem/upgrad: in src's repository: the tree before the last upgrade, an archive's commit
files.run/http-token: the HTTP token's sha256 (sha256:<hex>, mode 600), written by token rotate; the engine reads it again within a second

key_line: command="/bin/bash DIR/bin/tandem remote --key-id ID",no-pty,no-port-forwarding,no-agent-forwarding,no-X11-forwarding[,from="..."] ssh-ed25519 AAAA... COMMENT
